mental_model.analogy: A dynamic viewport sliding over elements, adjusting bounds as constraints shift.
mental_model.description: Imagine a transparent window overlaid on a sequence of items. The window expands to include new inputs, and shrinks from the tail to exclude invalidated ones.

brute_force_journey.brute_force_description: Iterate through all possible subsegments, recalculating properties from scratch on every step.
brute_force_journey.inefficiency_observation: Overlapping bounds evaluate identical elements multiple times, resulting in quadratic runtimes.
brute_force_journey.optimization_concept: Reuse metrics from overlapping segments by adjusting boundaries (adding entry element, subtracting exit element).

animation_steps.description: Initialize left and right boundaries at index 0.
Move right pointer to expand the range.
Slide the window forward: shift left boundary.

variants.name: Fixed-size Range
variants.description: The sliding bounds maintain a constant diameter throughout execution.

variants.name: Variable-size Range
variants.description: The bounds expand or shrink dynamically to satisfy complex constraints.

common_mistakes.description: Failing to validate boundary bounds before checking element values.

interview_perspective: Highly popular in FAANG/HFT rounds testing sliding/pointer array manipulation.
